description:
Find auction-event links attached to public cars; use search_vehicles for car specifications and asking prices, or get_auction for one event's bid state.

- Filter the linked car, not the auction title: make='Toyota' with query='Premio' targets that model's vehicle adverts. Unpriced cars remain eligible because an auction need not have a retail asking price.
- page_size is a source-scan batch: inspecting 20 adverts can yield zero auction links. Keep batch size and filters fixed; follow next_page even after an empty items page. At the source limit, narrow the car filters instead of claiming an exhaustive search.
- Results are links, not retail offers or bid snapshots. Source counts describe cars scanned; get_auction checks ended or gated events. Anonymous discovery exposes no private lots and places no bid.

make.description: Case-insensitive manufacturer prefix, e.g. Toyota; intersects the vehicle query. Omit for all makes.

page.description: One-based source vehicle page; use returned next_page with unchanged filters. This is not a page of guaranteed auction matches.

page_size.description: Public vehicle listings inspected per source page. Auction links can be fewer than this value, including zero.

query.description: Make/model/trim phrase for candidate vehicles, e.g. Premio; omit to scan all public listings. Known Bangla/Banglish vocabulary is normalized.

name: search_auctions

next_page.description: Next source vehicle page; may also contain no auction links. Null at the last page or the page limit.

scanned_listing_count.description: Source vehicle records inspected on this page.

source_listing_count.description: Matching source vehicle listings across pages; not an auction count.

title: Discover car auction links
